verdict.limitations: The lateral projection of the chest X-ray makes it difficult to precisely evaluate the exact course and tip positions of the cardiac device leads within the heart chambers. Overlapping structures obscure the distal ends of the leads, preventing a definitive assessment of their stability. The question asks for interval changes and comparison between left and right lung bases, which cannot be determined from a single lateral chest X-ray. A prior study would be needed to assess interval changes, and a frontal view (e.g., PA or AP) would be necessary to adequately compare left and right lung bases.
